responsibility: Declares the pass-C semantic builder responsible for resolving constant-expression structure and types. It covers module/procedure scope replay, import handling, construction of constant expression trees for unary/binary/relation operators and designators, constructor-context tracking, pushes for specific constant meta-types and attributes, alias skipping, and final resolution of designator-declared constant types.
same_name_distinction: This definition module declares the pass-C constant-resolution builder API used by PCBuild; unlike PCSymBuild.mod, it lists the exported procedures for expression-tree construction, scope replay, and constant-type resolution without implementing them.
